sinopsis.es: Una joven afronta el diagnóstico de alzhéimer de su madre, una mujer llena de vida, en esta animación hondamente conmovedora adaptada de unas memorias gráficas, con las voces de Abbi Jacobson, Julia Louis-Dreyfus, Bryan Cranston, Seth Rogen y Bowen Yang.
sinopsis.en: A young woman deals with her vibrant mother’s Alzheimer diagnosis in this deeply moving animation adapted from a graphic memoir, with a voice cast including Abbi Jacobson, Julia Louis-Dreyfus, Bryan Cranston, Seth Rogen, and Bowen Yang.
